8.3.14.2 E2E_P44mProtectInit
[SWS_E2E_91089] Definition of API function E2E_P44mProtectInit
Upstream requirements: RS_E2E_08527, RS_E2E_08528
⌈
Service Name
E2E_P44mProtectInit
Syntax
Std_ReturnType E2E_P44mProtectInit (
E2E_P44mProtectStateType* StatePtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x69
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
None
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
StatePtr
Pointer to port/data communication state.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E2E_E_INPUTERR_NULL - null pointer passed
E2E_E_OK
Description
Initializes the protection state.
Available via
E2E.h
⌋
[SWS_E2E_91063]
Upstream requirements: RS_E2E_08528
⌈In case State is NULL, E2E_P44mProtectInit shall return immediately with E2E_E_
INPUTERR_NULL. Otherwise, it shall initialize the state structure, setting Counter to
0.⌋
